title: Binary Tree Right Side View
description:
You are given the `root` of a binary tree. Imagine standing to the right of the tree. Return the values you can see, from top to bottom (the rightmost node on each level).

Tests show trees in level order, left to right, with `None` for a missing child. For example `[3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7]` is a root `3` with children `9` and `20`, where `20` has children `15` and `7`.

**Constraints**

- The tree has 0 to 100 nodes.
